data.name: Deep Extraction Inc.
data.detailed_description:
You are part of a three-person recovery crew working for a large corporation. Your job is to retrieve valuable objects from the ocean floor. You use an old and outdated submarine that has been modified for this mission. Together with up to three friends, you must control the submarine and survive the dangerous dive into the deep sea.

The submarine cannot be operated by one player alone. Players must communicate and work together to move through narrow underwater caves and avoid obstacles. Mistakes can easily lead to failure, so teamwork is very important.

The game takes place in one handcrafted level. The main goal is to find and collect multiple airplane black boxes that are spread across the ocean floor. As you go deeper, the environment becomes more dangerous. Visibility is limited, the caves are tight, and the submarine systems can fail, making the mission harder over time.

During the mission, players slowly learn more about the company that hired them and the consequences of the recovery operation. The ocean contains more than just wreckage, and some discoveries raise questions about what you are really sent to retrieve.

Key Features:

  • 3-player co-op gameplay

    Play together with up to three players, each helping to control the submarine.

  • Team based submarine control

    The submarine requires cooperation and communication to operate properly.

  • Objective focused gameplay

    Locate and recover airplane black boxes and other important objects.

  • Atmospheric underwater setting

  • Explore dark and dangerous underwater caves with limited visibility.

  • Environmental storytelling

    Learn more about the company and the mission through the environment.

  • No DLC or microtransactions

    The full game experience is included in the base game.
